text:
jon_sales: Hey CS team — handing off GreenSprout (trial -> pilot). Quick context: $120k ARR target, pilot ends 3/31, customer needs <50ms p50 for generation in EU region, wants SSO (Okta) + IP allowlist, and evaluating a private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated. Current hosted requests hit rate limits during sim load. Renewal/expansion signal strong but timeline tight. Please own onboarding and triage infra asks. Link to deal notes: https://crm.example/DEAL-4782 :point_right:

amanda_se: Noted. They were using our small hosted model (gptx-small) for eval. Were asking about quantized performance on A100 vs T4. Also asked about encrypted key rotation (KMS).

jon_sales: Correct. Expected steady QPS ~ 45 req/min during peak with avg 120 tokens out, 60 tokens in. Ramp plan: 1wk staging -> go-live. Customer said compliance team requires audit logs and KMS/HSM.

emma_cs: Thanks for the context. I'll take ownership of onboarding. Priya, can you pair on infra validation? Noah, we'll need a support escalation path for private deploy.

priya_cs_engineer: Happy to. Quick infra Qs: do they require VPC peering or NAT egress-only? Also which region is customer expecting EU?

jon_sales: EU-west (Frankfurt). They want egress through their TGW and control plane in our managed plane. VPC peering + VPN.

noah_support: I'm in. Will open a support runbook and assign an on-call eng contact. Can someone confirm expected peak tokens/s so we can size Dedicated?

sean_eng: tagging in engineering notes. If 45 req/min * 120 tokens ~ 5400 tokens/min -> 90 tokens/sec. For p50 <50ms we'll probably need a smaller model on A100 or a quantized xpu on T4 with 8-bit. Need exact concurrency and KV cache hit expectations. Also need model file and tokenizer version.

jon_sales: Concurrency estimate: concurrent sessions ~ 6. KV cache: low reuse (many unique prompts). Model variant: gptx-small v1.3 (tokenizer v1). I put model URL in the deal notes.

priya_cs_engineer: Copy. Creating onboarding checklist:
- SSO: Okta SCIM config (customer tenant)
- VPC peering + IP allowlist
- KMS key exchange (customer KMS ARN)
- Dedicated capacity sizing (eng input)
- Audit log retention policy (customer wants 1y)
- Run staging tests (latency/load)

emma_cs: I'll own SSO and customer comms. Priya you'll own infra validation + staging test plan. Noah you'll own support runbook & on-call escalation mapping. Sean you'll provide capacity guidance and a short perf doc by EOD.

amanda_se: I'll join the first staging run and handle acceptance criteria with customer.

jon_sales: Thanks team. One more ask: CS to capture feedback about prompt patterns — customer uses multi-turn chat with structured JSON outputs, they care about chained tool calls.

priya_cs_engineer: Noted — we'll include prompt set for regression tests. Can you paste 2 representative prompts here?

jon_sales: Sure:
```
User: Summarize the policy doc and extract critical action items.
System: return JSON [{"action":"string","owner":"string","due":"date"}] only.
```

And:
```
User: Rewrite customer-facing template with product names substituted.
```

emma_cs: Good — we'll add those to the eval harness. Priya will run them during staging and log outputs to the quality dashboard.

priya_cs_engineer: Opening internal tickets now:
- ENG-9243: Dedicated sizing + kernel recommendation (sean_eng assigned)
- OPS-1182: VPC peering & KMS onboarding (noah_support assigned)
- CS-5590: SSO SCIM setup + onboarding emails (emma_cs assigned)
Links: https://tickets.example/ENG-9243, https://tickets.example/OPS-1182, https://tickets.example/CS-5590

noah_support: OPS-1182 created. I've added runbook template and a tentative on-call rotation. I'll ping infra on call for the initial peering window.

sean_eng: I'll take ENG-9243. Quick note: if KV cache reuse is low, batching is less effective; we should plan for higher compute. I'll produce a recommended instance type and quantization option by EOD.

deploy-bot: Scheduled private deploy preview window: 2026-04-01 02:00-04:00 UTC (tentative) — OPS-1182 updated.

emma_cs: Team, next steps and owners recap:
- Emma (CS): SSO + customer comms — due 2026-03-28
- Priya (CS Eng): Infra validation, staging tests, prompt regression — due 2026-03-29
- Noah (Support): Runbook & escalation + peering ops — due 2026-03-27
- Sean (Eng): Capacity sizing doc + kernel recommendations — due EOD 2026-03-24
- Amanda (SE): Acceptance criteria & join staging — available 2026-03-30

jon_sales: Appreciate it. I'll set up a 30-min handoff call tomorrow 10am CET and include customer (okta admin + infra lead).

priya_cs_engineer: Added checklist to CS onboarding board and invited customer to a staging test workspace.

noah_support: Noted. If anyone hits blockers on VPN/TGW policy, tag me and I'll escalate to netops. :thumbsup:

sean_eng: Uploaded a short perf note to ENG-9243 with initial sizing assumptions. Will refine after we get concurrency confirmation.

emma_cs: Closing the handoff thread here. If anything changes ping @emma_cs or update CS-5590. :rocket:
